d:
The Heat defeated the Hawks, 129-117 tonight in Atlanta. Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with a team-high 24 points along with 18 rebounds and 3 assists for the Heat, while Bam Adebayo tallied 24 points, 9 rebounds and 3 steals in the game. Nickeil Alexander-Walker recorded 23 points, 5 three pointers and 3 rebounds. The Heat improve their record to 1-4 with the win, while the Hawks fall to 2-3 for the season.
